description: This file defines the ContentDescription class, which is a Java entity representing content descriptions in a content management system. It includes fields for URL, meta keywords, title, and description, and manages database interactions via JPA annotations.

classes.name: ContentDescription
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing content description details, including URL, meta tags, and associations to Content and Language.

methods.name: getMetatagTitle
methods.description: Returns the meta title of the content description.

methods.name: setMetatagTitle
methods.description: Sets the meta title of the content description.

methods.name: getSeUrl
methods.description: Returns the search engine friendly URL.

methods.name: setSeUrl
methods.description: Sets the search engine friendly URL.
